questions.passage: The Bentonville square keeps its brick storefronts, and on warm evenings the windows stay lit long after the last shop door is locked. Residents call that glow a courtesy.
questions.prompt: As used in the sample text, what does the word "courtesy" most nearly mean?
questions.staticRationale: The lit windows are described as a kindness to people still on the square, so courtesy means a polite kindness.
